one_line: Persian master metalworker in Bidar, whose craft with local artisans shaped the enduring black-and-silver Bidriware tradition.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, lean but strong craftsman’s build with calloused hands and confident posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a slightly sharp jaw, wheatish-olive complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed medium-length black beard and moustache; thoughtful, focused dark eyes with slight under-eye shadows; default expression is calm intensity, as if studying a design.
appearance.hair: Black hair, medium length but mostly hidden under a simple dark indigo cotton Persian-style cap (kulah) that fits close to the skull; a few short strands visible at the temples and sideburns neatly blending into his beard.
appearance.costume: Long knee-length cotton jama in soft off-white with a wrap-over front tied by an inner string and a narrow V-neck, worn over a pale sky-blue long-sleeved undershirt; the jama has slim sleeves and subtle fine vertical stripe weaving; around his waist is a deep maroon cloth sash (patka) wrapped twice and knotted to one side, ends hanging to mid-thigh with a faint woven geometric border in dull gold; loose straight-cut trousers (paijama) in light grey cotton gather slightly at the ankles and are tucked into simple brown leather mojari-style shoes with softly upturned toes and minimal stitching; over his shoulders he sometimes drapes a light, unpatterned, undyed cotton shawl (like a small chadar) that falls evenly down both sides, useful to wrap around his hands while working; jewellery is minimal—a plain silver band ring on his right hand and a small, simple silver amulet pendant on a black cotton cord, tucked modestly under his jama.
appearance.signature: A medium-sized, unfinished blackened Bidriware hookah base held in his left hand, its bulbous zinc-copper alloy body already darkened with fort soil patina and inset with bright silver inlay of stylised Persian scrolls and local Deccan-floral motifs, and in his right hand a slim, slightly curved steel inlay chisel with a simple wooden handle stained dark from use.

ref_desc: Abdullah bin Kaiser is a late-30s lean craftsman with an oval wheatish face, neat black beard, dark indigo cap, off-white knee-length jama over sky-blue sleeves, maroon waist sash, light grey trousers, brown mojari shoes, carrying an unfinished blackened Bidriware hookah base and a slim steel inlay chisel.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Abdullah bin Kaiser of Bidar: a late-30s lean craftsman with an oval wheatish face, sharp nose, thoughtful dark eyes, and a neatly trimmed medium-length black beard and moustache, hair mostly hidden under a simple dark indigo cotton Persian-style cap. His default expression is calm, focused intensity. He wears a historically accurate 15th-century Deccan outfit: a knee-length off-white cotton jama with a wrap-over front, narrow V-neck, slim sleeves, and subtle fine vertical stripes, worn over pale sky-blue long sleeves showing at the forearms. Around his waist is a deep maroon cloth sash wrapped twice and knotted to one side, ends hanging with a faint dull-gold geometric border. He has loose straight-cut light grey cotton trousers gathered slightly at the ankles, tucked into simple brown leather mojari-style shoes with gently upturned toes. A light undyed cotton shawl is draped over his shoulders and hangs down both sides of his torso. He wears a plain silver ring on his right hand and a small silver amulet pendant on a black cord, mostly hidden under the jama. In his left hand he holds a medium-sized, unfinished blackened Bidriware hookah base with a bulbous body, the dark zinc-copper alloy contrasting with bright silver inlay of stylised Persian scrolls and Deccan floral motifs; in his right hand he holds a slim slightly curved steel inlay chisel with a dark wooden handle. Show him from head to toe with consistent colours and clear views of face, cap, clothing layers, sash, trousers, shoes, and his Bidriware hookah base and chisel, in a clean educational anime style with no text anywhere.
